plainTranslation: Their uncompromising need for autonomy lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, bringing forward parts of you that do not want to perform for approval.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their uncompromising need for autonomy lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, bringing forward parts of you that do not want to perform for approval.
summaryDeep: Their uncompromising need for autonomy lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, bringing forward parts of you that do not want to perform for approval. Around them, you may show refusal, directness, or a less edited side of yourself more openly than usual. This can feel honest or confrontational depending on whether each person leaves room for the other's boundaries.
